content:
Although Ted Lasso Season 4 still has quite a few new episodes that haven't aired yet, according to the latest report from Sigmund Judge, the wait for Season 5 after the Season 4 finale may not be too long.

It is reported that Apple will begin filming Ted Lasso Season 5 starting in January next year.

When Ted Lasso Season 3 wrapped in 2023, it felt as if the entire series had come to an end. Although many viewers (and even the cast) hoped the show would continue, the future remained uncertain.

Now that Ted Lasso has finally returned, all signs indicate that Apple and Jason Sudeikis are planning to film several more seasons.

A series of posts published by Sigmund Judge on X today brought good news on this matter.

Judge had previously accurately reported breaking news on Ted Lasso and other Apple TV-related series.

Since filming is set to begin just a few months from now, there's a good chance we'll see Ted Lasso Season 5 return on Apple TV in 2027.

New episodes of Season 4 will continue airing until October 7, so there's still plenty of Lasso content to enjoy during this period. Although Apple has yet to officially confirm the renewal, there's a good chance they'll announce the start of Season 5 as Season 4 wraps up.

In related news, Bad Monkey, another Apple series from Ted Lasso co-creator Bill Lawrence, will return later this year, while his other popular series Shrinking is expected to air its Season 4 in early 2027.

Season 5 of Ted Lasso filming so soon — are you excited? Feel free to let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and is also available through the Apple One bundle subscription.
